basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old software developer living in Boston, Massachusetts. I'm a huge fan of open-world video games, especially Red Dead Redemption 2, which I play extensively whenever I get the chance. When I'm not gaming, I love to explore the New England countryside and dabble in electronics projects. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to pursue my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for over a decade. I'm self-taught in electronics and often contribute to discussions in rfelectronics. My gaming knowledge, especially in Red Dead Redemption, comes from years of playing and engaging with the community.
